intro:
A **45-minute** timed test on the whole of Energy — work, energy definitions and types, gravitational potential energy, kinetic energy, conservation of energy, spring potential energy, and the work-energy theorem. It is **generated fresh every time you open it**: a new set of questions drawn from across the unit, in a new order, with the answer choices shuffled.

The mix follows the Physics Academy test blueprint (`docs/test-generation.md`). BASIS Physics 8 is a pre-AP course, so the energy accounting stays scalar (no 2-D work or power), but the reasoning is held to AP Physics 1 rigor.

**No calculator.** Every multiple-choice item is built to be solved by hand. Multiple choice is scored automatically; free response is scored by you against the model answer and rubric.
